scope: read-only implementation, registered protocol, schema and current process audit; no new model development predictions opened

protocol.development_status: previously inspected; not new independent confirmation
protocol.metric_target_precision: original float64 truth from 47 classical replay
protocol.selection_criterion: mean of TEMP and SALT pooled standardized RMSE using depth-wise training scales; three-seed ensemble predictions for registered learned families
protocol.selection_candidates: all complete registered three-seed families, all replayed classical references, fixed existing learned OI; fixed single-seed MLP is comparison-only
protocol.satellite_condition: noise-free CESM2 5 m SST/SSS plus steric sea level derived from same 3-D T/S truth; new common-cache recipe, not historical missing-artifact replay
protocol.preprocessing_scope: training-year normalization fits all profiles in those years, including heldout cohort; it excludes 2004/2005 but is not an unseen-float preprocessing guarantee

schema_paths.neural_row_lookup: rows where row.mode == mode and row.family == family and row.kind != classical
schema_paths.fixed_row_lookup: rows where row.mode == argo and row.family == family and row.kind == classical
schema_paths.classical_kind_warning: 53 encodes fixed MLP and existing learned OI as kind=classical for reporting; they remain learned single-seed methods
schema_paths.selected_row_mapping: selected.kind in {classical, existing_learned_oi} => use fixed argo row even when selection mode is surface
schema_paths.physical_metrics_seed_statistics: row.seed_mean_sd[TEMP|SALT][metric].mean and .sd; n is integer directly
schema_paths.component_family: soft_moe192 only; these contrasts do not belong to arbitrary selected family
schema_paths.derived_relative_gain: 100 * (reference physical RMSE - candidate physical RMSE) / reference physical RMSE, on same seed-mean or ensemble basis

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 新系统保留逐深度 T/S 数值和有效标记，并额外通过局部数值通路读取新息；旧版在四个深度带内对逐层 embedding 做 masked mean。
新系统均值从冻结的球面 OI 开始，零初始化全局残差和局部 gate；经过训练的网络提供附加修正。
在相同数据、输入池、目标、评分点与 15k-step 预算下，新完整系统相对于重跑旧版的温盐误差降低。
required_conditions: all 39 registered runs actually completed 15000 steps
same mode old/new rows; do not substitute historical untraceable multimodal numbers
report each variable physical RMSE, same seed-mean or ensemble basis
point estimate delta_rmse < 0 for each variable claimed; describe confidence interval separately
identify optimizer/loss/schedule/precision/capacity changes as full-system confounds

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 验证集选中的方案超过此前 120 参数 learned OI 强基线。
required_conditions: existing learned OI parity remains verified
compare physical RMSE against that fixed seed-1234 1500-step checkpoint
both-variable improvement requires both deltas < 0
if selected prior_learned_oi itself, say previous best retained; no new-model improvement
only development evidence; no independent SOTA claim

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 共享 latent 给 SoftMoE192 在指定输入模式下带来额外精度收益。
required_conditions: use full-minus-latent_off of same mode
specify SoftMoE192, frozen OI and shared numerical local/query route
report variable-wise deltas and paired seed statistics
do not transfer this attribution to Dense192/Local Transformer/old/OI winner
both variable claims require both corresponding improvements

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 新增局部数值通路给 Argo-only SoftMoE192 带来额外精度收益。
required_conditions: use Argo-only full-minus-local_off
do not claim surface local-path ablation was run
do not confuse local_off with removal of original fixed OI
do not transfer this attribution to Dense/Local Transformer

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 增加相同 CESM2 表层产品后，同一 family 的精度改变。
required_conditions: same family present in both modes
use paired common scoring points and seed statistics
do not infer satellite benefit by comparing different selected families
report synthetic truth-derived product limitation and different encoding forms
do not generalize to real noisy independent satellite data

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 选定模型的边际 Gaussian 不确定性在本开发数据上具有更好的校准或概率预测质量。
required_conditions: compare coverage to nominal values 0.6827 and 0.95 along with NLL, CRPS and interval scale
coverage closer to 95% alone is insufficient if intervals simply widen
OI scales calibrated on 2004 residual RMS only, not analytic posterior
ensemble scores use moment-matched Gaussian, not exact mixture likelihood
distinguish learned uncertainty from single-seed vs ensemble performance

admissible_claims.statement_cn: 最终 backbone 按冻结的验证集规则选择。
required_conditions: all registered families complete before freeze
final report must preserve frozen validation winner even if another architecture ranks best in 2005
surface group may retain Argo-only fixed comparator if surface-enabled families fail to improve

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 旧模型没有 latent，因此本轮全部提升来自首次加入 latent。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 旧 D4RTFusion/Perceiver 风格模型本来已有共享 latent。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: Soft MoE、Perceiver IO 通用结构本身是我们的原创。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 这是已有通用方法；只能讨论本任务的数值通路、更新方案及验证后的具体组合。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: Dense64 到 Dense192 或 Dense192 到 SoftMoE 的结果证明 attention 本身更好。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: Dense64→192同时改变宽度、latents、blocks、heads与参数量；Soft MoE替换FFN并改变容量，不是attention唯一变化。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: latent 压缩没有丢失任何观测信息。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 保留独立数值通路不等于共享 latent 本身无信息损失；未做这一证据审计。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: latent 执行解析精确 Kalman 后验更新或严格观测插值。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: learned attention/residual/signed gate没有这一数学保证；exact只可描述读取实际数值或固定OI实现。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 复制记录不增加信息，独立噪声观测严格增加信息，相关性得到正确 DFS 估计。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 新attention仅模态prior平衡，无重复证据去重、独立信息量或precision合并实验。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 已证明任意位置、任意深度、任意日的连续3-D状态。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 本轮评分20个原生固定深度和月尺度时间；query接口通用不等于已验证。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 已证明未来预报、严格因果、跨海盆迁移或transfer预训练。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 本轮没有观测截止实验、独立迁移或pretraining arms。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 已经达到独立测试SOTA或超过原论文已发表结果。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 2005已反复使用；4DVarNet为作者代码任务适配，输入接口和训练配方不同。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: Soft MoE实现稀疏专家计算、token dropping或较低FLOPs。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 全部experts都计算，未做有效FLOPs/标准设备计时对照；共享GPU墙钟不可用于效率结论。

unsupported_claims.statement_cn: 当前旧surface/4DVarNet行精确重放用户粘贴的0.2124/0.0371等历史行。
unsupported_claims.reason_cn: 这些历史脚本、权重、全量预测不可定位；当前是共同缓存上的新注册recipe。

decision_rules.winner_mapping: use frozen selection selected family, including classic or existing learned OI; never force a Transformer/MoE
decision_rules.if_prior_or_classic_wins_cn: 保留验证集选中的既有/经典方案为当前生产基线；新增 latent/MoE 作为未验证优于强基线的研究分支。不能把候选设计写成最终已决定的获胜 backbone。
decision_rules.if_ablation_wins_cn: 最终结构应明确关闭被选项对应组件；不能仍称保留完整 latent 或局部通路。
decision_rules.if_dense_or_local_wins_cn: 准确记录获胜 Dense/Local 参数、blocks和输入；SoftMoE消融只能说明SoftMoE候选的组件收益，不构成该赢家的组件证明。
decision_rules.if_soft_moe_full_wins_cn: 是否能把共享latent/局部通路列为实证贡献仍分别取决于对应full-minus-off；surface没有local-off证据。
decision_rules.month_interval_supports_gain: ci95_delta_rmse[1] < 0; if interval includes 0 call it point-estimate decrease, not established gain
decision_rules.both_variables_gain: require criterion separately for TEMP and SALT; pooled selection alone is insufficient
decision_rules.novelty_statement_policy: separate implemented design, measured supported contribution, unresolved novelty hypothesis; reference existing architecture/assimilation precedents
decision_rules.if_no_neural_gain_cn: 可以报告可靠的强基线复现、完整比较及失败机制，但不得写成新backbone的精度突破。
decision_rules.final_model_count: a learned frozen candidate is a three-seed ensemble recommendation; state per-model architecture and three-model inference separately
